00148:     private function is_hangar18_managed_frontend_page() {
00149:         if (!is_page()) {
00150:             return false;
00151:         }
00152: 
00153:         $page_id = (int) get_queried_object_id();

00155:             return false;
00156:         }
00157: 
00158:         $post = get_post($page_id);
00159:         if (!$post instanceof WP_Post) {
00160:             return false;
00161:         }

01264:     private function bool_value($value, $default = false) {
01265:         if ($value === null) {
01266:             return (bool) $default;
01267:         }
01268: 
01269:         if (is_bool($value)) {
01270:             return $value;
01271:         }
01272: 
01273:         if (is_int($value) || is_float($value)) {
01274:             return ((int) $value) !== 0;
01275:         }
01276: 
01277:         $text = strtolower(trim((string) $value));
01278: 
01279:         if (in_array($text, ['true', '1', 'yes', 'on'], true)) {
01280:             return true;
01281:         }
01282: 
01283:         if (in_array($text, ['false', '0', 'no', 'off', ''], true)) {
01284:             return false;
01285:         }
01286: 
01287:         return (bool) $default;
01288:     }
01289: 
01290:     private function clamp_int($value, $minimum, $maximum, $default) {
01291:         if (!is_numeric($value)) {
01292:             $value = $default;
01293:         }
01294: 
01295:         $value = (int) $value;
01296:         return max((int) $minimum, min((int) $maximum, $value));
01297:     }

07698:     private function get_page_presets() {
07699:         $stored = get_option(self::PAGE_PRESETS_OPTION, []);
07700:         if (!is_array($stored)) {
07701:             return [];
07702:         }
07703: 
07704:         $presets = [];
07705:         foreach (array_slice($stored, 0, 50, true) as $id => $entry) {
07706:             if (!is_array($entry) || !isset($entry['Section']) || !is_array($entry['Section'])) {
07707:                 continue;
07708:             }
07709:             $preset_id = sanitize_key((string) ($entry['Id'] ?? $id));
07710:             $name = sanitize_text_field((string) ($entry['Name'] ?? 'Genbrugelig komponent'));
07711:             if ($preset_id === '' || $name === '') {
07712:                 continue;
07713:             }
07714:             $section = $this->normalize_page_section($entry['Section'], 0);
07715:             if ($section['Type'] === 'legacy') {
07716:                 continue;
07717:             }
07718:             $section['Key'] = '';
07719:             $section['Order'] = 10;
07720:             $presets[$preset_id] = [
07721:                 'Id'         => $preset_id,
07722:                 'Name'       => $name,
07723:                 'UpdatedUtc' => sanitize_text_field((string) ($entry['UpdatedUtc'] ?? '')),
07724:                 'Section'    => $section,
07725:             ];
07726:         }
07727:         return $presets;
07728:     }

07743:             wp_send_json_error(['message' => 'Komponentdata mangler eller er for stor.'], 400);

07730:     public function ajax_save_page_preset() {
07731:         if (!current_user_can('edit_pages')) {
07732:             wp_send_json_error(['message' => 'Du har ikke rettigheder til at gemme komponenter.'], 403);
07733:         }
07734:         check_ajax_referer('h18_page_presets_v051', 'nonce');
07735: 
07736:         $name = sanitize_text_field((string) wp_unslash($_POST['name'] ?? ''));
07737:         $name = function_exists('mb_substr') ? mb_substr($name, 0, 80) : substr($name, 0, 80);
07738:         $json = (string) wp_unslash($_POST['section'] ?? '');
07739:         if ($name === '') {
07740:             wp_send_json_error(['message' => 'Komponenten skal have et navn.'], 400);
07741:         }
07742:         if ($json === '' || strlen($json) > 120000) {
07743:             wp_send_json_error(['message' => 'Komponentdata mangler eller er for stor.'], 400);
07744:         }
07745: 
07746:         $raw = json_decode($json, true);
07747:         if (!is_array($raw) || json_last_error() !== JSON_ERROR_NONE) {
07748:             wp_send_json_error(['message' => 'Komponentdata er ikke gyldig JSON.'], 400);
07749:         }
07750: 
07751:         $section = $this->normalize_page_section($raw, 0);
07752:         if ($section['Type'] === 'legacy') {
07753:             wp_send_json_error(['message' => 'Eksisterende legacy-indhold kan ikke gemmes som komponent.'], 400);
07754:         }
07755:         $section['Key'] = '';
07756:         $section['Order'] = 10;
07757: 
07758:         $presets = $this->get_page_presets();
07759:         $preset_id = sanitize_key((string) wp_unslash($_POST['preset_id'] ?? ''));
07760:         if ($preset_id === '' || !isset($presets[$preset_id])) {
07761:             $preset_id = 'preset-' . sanitize_key(wp_generate_uuid4());
07762:         }
07763: 
07764:         $entry = [
07765:             'Id'         => $preset_id,
07766:             'Name'       => $name,
07767:             'UpdatedUtc' => gmdate('c'),
07768:             'Section'    => $section,
07769:         ];
07770:         $presets[$preset_id] = $entry;
07771:         if (count($presets) > 50) {
07772:             $presets = array_slice($presets, -50, null, true);
07773:         }
07774:         update_option(self::PAGE_PRESETS_OPTION, $presets, false);
07775:

07780:     public function ajax_delete_page_preset() {
07781:         if (!current_user_can('edit_pages')) {
07782:             wp_send_json_error(['message' => 'Du har ikke rettigheder til at slette komponenter.'], 403);
07783:         }
07784:         check_ajax_referer('h18_page_presets_v051', 'nonce');
07785: 
07786:         $preset_id = sanitize_key((string) wp_unslash($_POST['preset_id'] ?? ''));
07787:         $presets = $this->get_page_presets();
07788:         if ($preset_id === '' || !isset($presets[$preset_id])) {
07789:             wp_send_json_error(['message' => 'Komponenten blev ikke fundet.'], 404);
07790:         }
07791:         $name = (string) $presets[$preset_id]['Name'];
07792:         unset($presets[$preset_id]);
07793:         update_option(self::PAGE_PRESETS_OPTION, $presets, false);
07794:         $this->log('INFO', 'PAGE_PRESET_DELETED', "Genbrugelig komponent '{$name}' ({$preset_id}) blev slettet.");
07795:         wp_send_json_success(['preset_id' => $preset_id]);
07796:     }

07798:     private function page_module_storage_key($page_id, $section_key) {
07799:         return substr(hash('sha256', (int) $page_id . '|' . sanitize_key((string) $section_key)), 0, 24);
07800:     }
07801: 
07802:     private function find_page_module($page_id, $section_key, $expected_type, $must_be_active = true) {
07803:         $page = get_post((int) $page_id);
07804:         if (!$page instanceof WP_Post) {
07805:             return [null, null];
07806:         }
07807:         $data = $this->get_page_editor_data($page->post_name, $page);
07808:         foreach ($data['Sections'] as $section) {
07809:             if (
07810:                 $section['Key'] === sanitize_key((string) $section_key) &&
07811:                 $section['Type'] === $expected_type &&
07812:                 (!$must_be_active || !empty($section['Active']))
07813:             ) {
07814:                 return [$page, $section];
07815:             }
07816:         }
07817:         return [$page, null];
07818:     }

07074:                     $valid_parent = false;
07075:                     break;

07080:                     $valid_parent = false;
07081:                     break;

07084:             }

07087:             }
07088:         }

06717:     private function normalize_page_section(array $raw, $index = 0, array $legacy_source = []) {
06718:         $types = $this->page_section_type_labels();
06719:         $type = sanitize_key((string) ($raw['Type'] ?? 'text'));
06720:         if (!isset($types[$type])) {

06722:         }
06723:         if (in_array($type, ['html', 'text'], true) && $this->looks_like_page_css((string) ($raw['Content'] ?? ''))) {

06725:         }
06726:

06731:         }
06732:

06734:         if (!in_array($alignment, ['Left', 'Center'], true)) {
06735:             $alignment = 'Left';
06736:         }
06737:         $mobile_alignment = (string) ($raw['MobileAlignment'] ?? 'Center');
06738:         if (!in_array($mobile_alignment, ['Left', 'Center'], true)) {
06739:             $mobile_alignment = 'Center';
06740:         }
06741:         $background = (string) ($raw['Background'] ?? 'White');
06742:         if (!in_array($background, ['White', 'OffWhite', 'Olive', 'Sand', 'Steel'], true)) {
06743:             $background = 'White';
06744:         }
06745:         $image_position = (string) ($raw['ImagePosition'] ?? 'Right');
06746:         if (!in_array($image_position, ['Left', 'Right'], true)) {
06747:             $image_position = 'Right';
06748:         }
06749:         $image_aspect = (string) ($raw['ImageAspectRatio'] ?? 'Auto');
06750:         if (!in_array($image_aspect, ['Auto', '1:1', '4:3', '3:2', '16:9'], true)) {
06751:             $image_aspect = 'Auto';
06752:         }

08119:     private function render_page_editor_section_front($page_id, array $section, $layout_children = '') {
08120:         if (empty($section['Active'])) {
08121:             return '';
08122:         }
08123:         if ($section['Type'] === 'legacy') {

08125:         }

08146:             $content = wp_kses_post($content_source);
08147:         } elseif ($section['Type'] === 'shortcode') {
08148:             $content = !empty($section['AdvancedContentAuthorized'])

08153:         }

08155:

08157:             $justify_map = ['Start'=>'flex-start','Center'=>'center','End'=>'flex-end','SpaceBetween'=>'space-between'];
08158:             $align_map = ['Start'=>'flex-start','Center'=>'center','End'=>'flex-end','Stretch'=>'stretch'];
08159:             $style .= '--h18-layout-gap:' . (int) $section['LayoutGapPx'] . 'px;' .
